definitions.gloss: ten people; a group of ten
definitions.explanation: Ten as a count of people. Uses {人|にん}, the standard counter for people, attached to {十|じゅう} (ten). Note: 1 person is {一人|ひとり} and 2 people is {二人|ふたり} (irregular), but 3 onward use ~{人|にん}.

examples.japanese: {十|じゅう}{人|にん}⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十|じゅう}{人|にん}⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧{お願|ねが}い⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{留学|りゅうがく}{生|せい}→留学生：02986_ryuugakusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{十|じゅう}{人|にん}⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|き}ている→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: There are ten exchange students in this class, each from a different country.

notes:
Counting form for ten people using the standard counter ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十|じゅう}{人|にん}⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: there are ten people
- {十|じゅう}{人|にん}⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧: ten people gather
- {十|じゅう}{人|にん}⟦{分|ぶん}→分：26216_bun⟧: enough for ten people; ten people's portion
- {十|じゅう}{人|にん}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦{九|きゅう}{人|にん}→九人：30570_kyuunin⟧: nine out of ten (people)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
{十|じゅう}{人|にん}{十|と}{色|いろ} (じゅうにんといろ) — 'ten people, ten colors', meaning everyone is different / to each their own.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧: one person (irregular)
- ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧: two people (irregular)
- ⟦{三人|さんにん}→三人：10978_sannin⟧: three people
- ⟦{何人|なんにん}→何人：17593_nannin⟧: how many people
